New certification: docs/conformance/programs/14_signature_contracts.aipo (parameter, checked default, T?, Function, struct contract, mutable receiver and return), docs/conformance/programs/15_invariant_on_mutation.aipo (commit, rollback at a method boundary, rollback at a direct assignment, rollback of two participating instances), docs/conformance/diagnostics/12_runtime_contract_violation.aipo and 13_runtime_return_contract.aipo (contract faults) and 14_runtime_invariant_mutation_uncaught.aipo (uncaught recoverable Failure). At the VM layer: test_guarded_mutation_rolls_back_at_boundary, test_signature_contract_violation_is_a_fault and test_nullable_contract_accepts_none in crates/aipo-vm/tests/data_and_errors.rs, plus the emitter/verifier/disassembler round trip for AssertContract, CheckMutations and AssertInvariant in crates/aipo-bytecode/src/lib.rs

cargo fmt --all -- --check (exit 0), cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings (zero warnings), cargo test --workspace (141 passed, 0 failed) and cargo doc --workspace --no-deps (no warnings) are all green; full output in docs/evidence/P00-G14-runtime-contract-enforcement.md

Decisions taken from canon instead of invented: an invariant on a published instance is re-validated at stable mutable boundaries with a per-frame mutation journal, restoring the direct fields of every participating instance and producing a recoverable Failure (Interludio - Chamadas, Construcao, Impl e Modulos, section 3); a signature contract violation discovered at runtime is a contract fault, not capturable by attempt (Language Reference section 4); T? means exactly T or none; the module's Type.invariant function entry is the predicate the runtime invokes, so no second expression evaluator exists. Recorded in docs/adp/ADP-002-construction-hooks-and-runtime-contracts.md, now resolved with G2b and G3 closed; the residual limits (interfaces are not checked at runtime, sema does not use the annotations before execution) are recorded there and in the evidence record instead of being hidden
